title: Modul POS - Kitchen Display System (KDS) - Panduan Lengkap
description: Panduan lengkap menggunakan Kitchen Display System untuk koordinasi order antara front-of-house dan kitchen, tracking progress persiapan, dan management multi-station kitchen.
author: Tim GIMS

content.body: Kitchen Display System (KDS) adalah digital display di kitchen untuk menerima order dari front-of-house (FoH), track persiapan item, dan coordinate antar kitchen stations. KDS hanya aktif di Mode B (F&B/Restaurant), untuk sinkronisasi realtime antara pelayanan customer dan persiapan kitchen.

KDS Display Locations: - Main KDS screen: Central display untuk semua order - Station KDS: Per-station display (Grill, Fryer, Beverage, Expedite) - Manager tablet: For monitor & control - FoH tablet/device: For order sending & status check Data Flow: ``` FoH Create Order ↓ [Send to Kitchen] ↓ Order Transmitted to KDS ↓ Kitchen Staff View KDS ↓ [Start Cooking] ↓ Mark Item Ready/Done ↓ Notify FoH (Bell/Alert) ↓ FoH Pickup & Serve ```

items.title: Main KDS Display
items.body: Layout Sections: 1. Header (Top Bar): - Current time (HH:MM:SS) - Session info: Outlet, date - Total pending orders - Connection status (online/offline) 2. Orders Queue (Main Area): - List orders dengan color-coded status: - BLUE: Fresh order (< 2 min) - YELLOW: Being prepared (2-10 min) - RED: Overdue (> est. time) - Per order display: - Order number - Table number & pax count - Order received time - Elapsed time (live counter) - Items list dengan qty & notes - Assigned station(s) 3. Quick Stats (Right Side): - Orders total: X - Average prep time: Y min - Busiest station: Z 4. Controls (Bottom Bar): - Settings button (configure KDS) - Help button - Logout button Order Card Display: ``` ┌─────────────────────────────────────┐ │ TABLE #3 (2 PAX) | 08:30 | 5 min │ ├─────────────────────────────────────┤ │ • Nasi Goreng × 2 (no garlic) │ │ • Gado-gado × 1 (medium spicy) │ │ • Es Teh × 3 │ ├─────────────────────────────────────┤ │ [Grill] [Fryer] [Expedite] │ │ Status: IN_PROGRESS │ └─────────────────────────────────────┘ ```

items.title: Station-Specific Display
items.body: Each kitchen station punya own KDS tablet/screen. Station KDS Layout: - Only show items relevant ke station ini - Example Grill station: Steak, grilled fish, grilled chicken - Example Fryer station: Fried chicken, fries, etc Display Details: ``` GRILL STATION ┌─────────────────────────────┐ │ ORDER #1 - TABLE 3 │ │ Steak × 1 (medium done) │ │ [COOKING] - 6 min elapsed │ │ Est. ready: 4 min more │ │ [Ready] [Delay] [Reprep] │ ├─────────────────────────────┤ │ ORDER #2 - TABLE 5 │ │ Grilled Fish × 2 │ │ [QUEUED] │ │ [Start] [Skip] │ ├─────────────────────────────┤ │ ORDER #3 - TABLE 1 │ │ Steak × 1 (rare) │ │ [QUEUED] │ └─────────────────────────────┘ Next: Start Cooking Order #2 ```

items.title: Step 1: Receive Order (Kitchen Staff)
items.body: 1. Order Arrives di KDS: - FoH staff send order dari tablet mereka - Order instantly muncul di KDS screen - Audio/visual alert (bell, beep) - New order highlight (blue color) - Kitchen staff see order 2. Order Info: - Table number & pax - All items dengan qty - Special request/notes per item - Timestamp order diterima 3. Acknowledge Order: - Kitchen staff click 'Start Cooking' atau similar - Order color change: Blue → Yellow (in progress) - Timestamp cooking start recorded

items.title: Step 2: Prepare Items
items.body: 1. Kitchen Staff mengambil order: - Read order detail dari KDS - Gather ingredients - Start cooking 2. Progress Tracking: - Order show elapsed time (live countdown) - Color change saat milestone: - Yellow: 2-10 min (normal progress) - Red: > 10 min (overdue/slow) - Alerts: If taking too long 3. Multi-Item Order: - Prepare items sequentially atau parallel - Example: - Nasi Goreng: Start first (longest) - Gado-gado: Start after (shorter) - Es Teh: Last (instant) - Coordinate timing untuk semua siap bersamaan 4. Quality Check: - Before mark ready: Check plating, taste, temperature - Fix issues immediately - Ensure consistency

items.title: Step 3: Mark Item Ready
items.body: 1. Item Selesai & Ready di Pass: - Staff click 'Ready' untuk item (atau seluruh order) - Status update di KDS - FoH get notified (bell, notification) 2. What Changes: - Item status: COOKING → READY - Display pada KDS: Green / Ready indicator - Order remain on KDS (sampai FoH confirm pickup) 3. Station Status: - If all station items for order ready: - Order → READY (semua item done) - Pass to expediter/FoH - If partial: - Order → PARTIAL READY - Show which items ready, which pending 4. Expiration: - Item too long di pass: Notification - Prevent cold dishes from sitting too long - Auto-alert after 5-10 min (configurable)

items.title: Step 4: Multi-Station Coordination
items.body: Scenario: Order dengan items dari multiple stations Order: Steak (grill) + Fried Chicken (fryer) + Salad (prep) + Drink (bar) 1. Order Split ke Stations: - FoH send order - System auto-route: - Grill station: Steak - Fryer station: Fried Chicken - Prep station: Salad - Bar: Drink - Each station see relevant items saja 2. Parallel Cooking: - All 4 station start simultaneously - Each work at own pace - No blocking (tidak tunggu station lain) 3. Coordination: - Grill: "Steak ready" (but wait untuk other stations) - Fryer: "Fried chicken ready" (hold di pass) - Prep: "Salad ready" - Bar: "Drink ready" - When ALL items ready → Expediter/Lead assemble & check - Then mark ORDER READY - Send ke FoH 4. Central Queue: - Main KDS show: Order ready when ALL stations done - Not when first station ready - Prevent incomplete orders going out 5. Problem Handling: - If one station slow: Auto-alert - Lead kitchen coordinate expedite - Prevent bottleneck

items.title: Step 5: Issue Handling - Reprep, Delay, Cancel
items.body: Scenario A: Salah Persiapan (Wrong Item) 1. Kitchen realize buat salad salah (ngasih yang pedes, tapi customer "not spicy") 2. Click 'Reprep' button di KDS 3. System update: - Item status → REPREP (being redone) - Note: "Redoing - wrong preparation" - Restart timer 4. Kitchen start ulang item 5. When fixed: Click 'Ready' again Scenario B: Item Delayed (Out of Stock/Issue) 1. Kitchen realize item out of stock (e.g., "Beef habis") 2. Click 'Delay' button 3. Dialog muncul: Input reason & estimated delay 4. System broadcast: - KDS notify: "Order #3 delayed - beef out of stock, ETA 15 min" - FoH get alert (untuk inform customer) - Customer: "Steak akan prepare, tunggu 15 menit" 5. Update: "Beef dari storage" atau "Switch menu?" 6. Either: - Kitchen proceed saat beef available - Or customer change menu Scenario C: Customer Cancel Item 1. Customer change mind: "Cancel salad, ganti somay" 2. FoH update order di KDS: Remove salad item 3. KDS update di prep station: - Prep station see: "Salad item REMOVED" - Click 'Confirm Cancel' - Don't prep salad 4. Add new item (somay) jika ada Scenario D: Full Order Cancel 1. Customer ingin cancel seluruh order 2. FoH click 'Void Order' di POS 3. System transmit cancel to KDS: - All stations see: "ORDER CANCELLED - #3" - Red alert / different color - Don't prepare 4. Kitchen acknowledge cancel

items.title: Configuring Kitchen Stations
items.body: Admin setup stations sesuai kitchen layout. Common Stations: - Grill: Steak, grilled fish, grilled chicken - Fryer: Fried items, fries - Saute: Stir-fry, sauces - Pastry: Desserts, breads - Beverage/Bar: Drinks, coffee - Prep/Salad: Cold items - Expediter/Assembly: Final plating Per-Station Settings: - Station name - Menu items assigned - Display device (KDS tablet) - Default prep time per item - Alert threshold (yellow/red timing) Example Configuration: ``` Station: Grill Items: Steak, Grilled Fish, Grilled Chicken Device: Tablet at grill station Default prep time: 12 min Yellow alert: > 8 min Red alert: > 12 min ```

items.title: Station Workflow
items.body: Typical Grill Station Workflow: 1. Display Show Items to Cook: - ORDER #1: Steak rare (grill) - ORDER #2: Grilled fish (grill) - ORDER #3: Chicken grilled (grill) 2. Station Lead Prioritize: - Look at order time (FIFO) - Look at est. prep time (express orders first) - Start cooking based priority 3. Start Cooking: - Click 'Start' button untuk order #1 - Put steak on grill - Timer start - KDS update order color 4. During Cooking: - Flip, season, check - Monitor timer on KDS - Adjust based on item type 5. Item Ready: - Place di pass area - Click 'Ready' button - KDS notify other stations & FoH 6. Expediter Assemble: - Wait untuk all stations items - Plate together - Quality check - Send ke FoH 7. FoH Pickup & Serve: - FoH come to pass - Take plated order - Verify all items - Serve ke table - Mark SERVED di POS

content.body: KDS Analytics: 1. Average Prep Time (per item): - Track: How long typically steak take? - Data: Sum(prep_time) / count(items) - Use: Set realistic timers, identify bottlenecks 2. Station Efficiency: - Orders/hour per station - Downtime tracking - Peak load times 3. Order Completion Rate: - On-time vs late orders - Delay reasons - Trends 4. Bottleneck Detection: - Which station slow? - When does it happen? - Root cause analysis 5. Report Dashboard: - Daily KDS report - Trending: Prep times, efficiency - Alert history (delays, errors) - Staff performance (if individual tracking)

1. Order Priority: - FIFO (First In First Out) generally - But expedite express orders - Coordinate dgn FoH untuk rush timing 2. Communication: - Use delay notification early - Don't silent about issues - Inform FoH → Inform customer 3. Quality Over Speed: - Don't rush & sacrifice quality - Better late & good than early & bad - Check before marking ready 4. Multi-Task Management: - Start long-cook items first - Overlap cooking (grill + fryer simultaneously) - Coordinate timing 5. Station Lead Coordination: - Lead guide team - Adapt to demand - Help if bottleneck 6. KDS Monitor: - Glance regularly - Check for new orders - Monitor overdue items (red alerts) - Act on delays early
